**Creator-reported model · Source-only; not independently reproduced**

Original 357×356 animated GIF: 12 distinct decoded frames, 180 ms each, 2.16 seconds total, infinite-loop metadata. Frame-by-frame review shows steam forming and dissolving a heart. Browser playback was documented during the 5 November source review; this audit rechecked the retained file and all frames. Flawless seamlessness and complete background immobility are not asserted.
